actions.description: Capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference.

inputs.description: Select one declared image source; each capture is independent.
inputs.name: camera

actions.name: capture

device.name: Easys simulated camera and balloon detector

facts.text: The README states Ubuntu 22.04, ROS 2 Humble and Gazebo Garden.
The simulation launch includes the ros_gz_sim Gazebo launch and starts the ros_gz_bridge parameter_bridge node with the bridge_topic.yaml config.
bridge_topic.yaml maps the ROS topic /camera to the Gazebo topic /camera with ROS type sensor_msgs/msg/Image and Gazebo type gz.msgs.Image.
The Easys camera sensor is named camera, type camera, with width 320, height 240, horizontal FOV 1.047, update rate 30 Hz and Gazebo topic camera.
balloon_detect imports Image from sensor_msgs.msg, subscribes to the absolute /camera topic with queue size 10 and creates an Image publisher on the relative image_processed topic with queue size 10.
image_callback converts the received frame from RGB to HSV, builds a red mask from two hue bands and blue and yellow masks, and passes each mask with the label Red, Blue or Yellow to mask2boudingbox.
mask2boudingbox finds the external contours of the mask it is given and, for each contour whose area exceeds 50, draws a green rectangle and the color label on the current frame.
image_callback converts the annotated frame back to an Image with cv2_to_imgmsg and encoding rgb8, passing no header, and publishes it with self.publisher.
The Under Water Robocon launch includes the simulation launch and starts the balloon_detect node.
bridge_topic.yaml maps four thruster command topics, /left_down/cmd_thruster, /right_down/cmd_thruster, /left_up/cmd_thruster and /right_up/cmd_thruster, from std_msgs/msg/Float64 to gz.msgs.Double.
bridge_topic.yaml also maps /tf as tf2_msgs/msg/TFMessage (Gazebo gz.msgs.Pose_V) and /imu as sensor_msgs/msg/Imu (Gazebo gz.msgs.IMU).
The simulation launch also starts robot_state_publisher, joy_node, the Easys_ros nodes joy2cmd, Easys_controller and thruster_output_converter, and rviz2.
The README's manual setup clones the separate Easys_ros repository next to Easys_sim.
The easys model declares a camera sensor named camera with width 320, height 240, update rate 30 Hz and Gazebo topic camera, like easys_a1.
The balloon_detect package manifest leaves its licence as 'TODO: License declaration'.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned image replies with no Gazebo render, camera timing, balloon detection or state-hash replay

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS-free canned camera packets (no renderer or detector)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free rosbridge contract stand-in: it answers the two declared Image subscriptions and runs no Gazebo Garden renderer, sensors system, ros_gz_bridge, balloon_detect, OpenCV mask or bounding-box code
the fake returns a 2x2 rgb8 placeholder frame, not the pinned sensor's 320x240 image; the real dimensions and the 30 Hz update rate are source facts, not the fake's timing or resolution
the /image_processed reply is a canned frame; the fake does not execute the detector, so it cannot show that a balloon was detected or annotated

the detector publishes the annotated frame without assigning a header (balloon_detect.py:85-89), so the detected stream's stamp and frame id are whatever cv_bridge's cv2_to_imgmsg leaves (cv_bridge is not in the clone and was not checked); the fake answers it with a zero stamp and an empty frame id as placeholders
only the Under Water Robocon launch (joy_sim.launch.xml) starts balloon_detect; with the default sim.launch.xml no node publishes /image_processed and a detected capture fails after its deadline

sim.launch.xml also starts joy_node and the Easys_ros joystick, controller and thruster nodes (Easys_ros is a separate repository, not in the clone); they command the thrusters independently of this package and an MHS e-stop does not stop them
the thruster command publications, /imu, /tf, the Gazebo world step, pause, reset and any vehicle motion are NOT COVERED by this passive camera package
the pinned clone declares no acknowledged ROS stop, pause or reset endpoint for this package; an e-stop latches in software and does not stop Gazebo or the detector node
no live ROS graph, Gazebo world, camera render or hardware run was performed; the evidence is contract_checked only

safe_state.description: The selected camera pipeline is passive: the pinned clone exposes no actuator, stop, pause, reset or world-control ROS endpoint for it. An MHS e-stop engages only the software latch and refuses new captures; it does not stop Gazebo, the balloon_detect node or any external thruster publisher.
